title: AI Receipt Tracker
description: Built a mobile-friendly, AI-assisted receipt tracker: scan a receipt, review the extracted transaction, then ask questions about spending in plain language. Gemini extracts receipt fields, with Tesseract OCR and DeepSeek as a fallback. The dashboard combines spending totals and category breakdowns with AI-generated summaries, while DeepSeek reviews statistically flagged unusual expenses. Built with React, FastAPI, and SQLAlchemy, keeping extracted amounts editable and model interpretation separate from SQL-calculated totals.

title: AWS IoT
description:
Hybrid Edge-to-Cloud IoT Monitor
Built a smart-plug monitoring system that combines local processing on an Orange Pi with AWS IoT Core for MQTT telemetry. Tracks energy usage, estimates electricity costs, and stores readings in MariaDB. A dashboard hosted on S3 and CloudFront accesses the local FastAPI service through Cloudflare Tunnel, with AWS infrastructure provisioned using Terraform.
Tech stack: Python · FastAPI · MariaDB · MQTT · AWS IoT Core · S3 · CloudFront · Terraform

title: AWS CI/CD Pipeline
description: Demonstrates modern cloud engineering practices by migrating a bare-metal application to a serverless AWS architecture.

title: Server Dashboard
description:
AI-Powered Homelab Dashboard
Built a real-time dashboard that brings together server health, IoT sensors, smart-plug energy usage, and network diagnostics. Integrated DeepSeek to generate SRE-style health summaries and interpret network anomalies, with Telegram alerts and remote status queries. Includes local smart-plug control, electricity-cost estimates, and configurable service management, built with Python and NiceGUI using an MVC architecture.
Tech stack: Python · NiceGUI · Prometheus · MQTT · MariaDB · DeepSeek · AWS DynamoDB · Docker · Kubernetes/Helm

title: Infra Agent Monitoring
description: Built an AI-assisted SRE agent that monitors infrastructure telemetry and uses Gemini to investigate anomalies. Combines live system data with AI-generated diagnostic insights, while requiring human approval before infrastructure actions.

title: IoT Switch
description:
Built a dashboard for monitoring and controlling Tuya smart plugs directly over the local network. Tracks live power, voltage, and current, with daily, weekly, and monthly energy charts and electricity-cost estimates based on configured TNB tariffs. Includes confirmation prompts for critical devices and stores energy history in MariaDB.
Tech stack: Python · NiceGUI · tinytuya · MariaDB · MQTT
